newOpenItem.title: Retained trial, consent and protocol catalogue qualifications

review.rationale: New access-guide fields do not recertify older catalogue context. Verify the undated fewer-than-one-in-ten participation statement with a defined population and period; distinguish specific emergency-research consent exceptions from a general deferred-consent rule and verify the cross-jurisdiction child/representative wording; qualify universal amendment-review and untraceable-analysis assertions in the protocol summary. These are separate from the source-first guide requirements and remain queued for direct source review.
